text:
mike: Heads up folks 16 tunnel between Embarcadero and 4th is reporting water on the tracks, BART says possible single-track. Anyone rerouting?

sana: Just got the alert. Im switching to bus but the 10 is doing the slow scenic route today.

brooke: Im on the 10. Confirming scenic route + puddle detours. Also lost one waterproof shoe to the puddle at 3rd & Mission. RIP.

leo: Took the ferry earlier, almost got blown into next county. Suggestion: bring a dry spare in your bag. Also holding a cup of hot coffee like its a tiny life raft.

transit-bot: BART system: "Single-track operation between Embarcadero and 4th St due to water intrusion. Expect 15-30 min delays." https://status.bart.example/alert/1987

mike: Quick poll: who wants to meet at the arcade corner for a dry coffee and shuttle convoy? React with :coffee: for yes, :wave: if on my way.

sana: :coffee: I will accept any beverage that promises warmth and optimism.

brooke: :wave: leaving now, I will carry a spare towel. Also will accept sympathy.

leo: :coffee: bringing granola bars as emotional support snacks.

mike: OK arcade corner in 10. If BART magically unsticks we pivot. Stay safe and keep phone batteries above 40%.

transit-bot: Muni: "10, 14 experiencing minor delays due to reroutes. Shuttle ETA 12m."
